  # Get Templates and Folders

The Get Templates and Folders endpoint returns every template and folder in your TurboDocx workspace, including each template's ID, name, parent folder, and tags. It is the starting point for most integrations: call it to discover the `TemplateId` values you pass to document generation, or to build a template picker inside your own app.

## When to use it

Use this endpoint to populate a "choose a template" dropdown, sync your template library into another system, or look up the ID of a template before generating a document or deleting it. Pass `showTags=true` when you want tag metadata for filtering, and use `limit` to page through large libraries.

## Example request

```bash
curl "https://api.turbodocx.com/template-item?limit=50&showTags=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TURBODOCX_API_KEY" \
  -H "x-rapiddocx-org-id: $TURBODOCX_ORG_ID" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

## Example response

```json
{
  "results": {
    "templateItems": [
      {
        "id": "2b8f1c9e-4d3a-4a7c-9f21-6b0d5e9a1c34",
        "name": "SOW Template",
        "type": "template",
        "folderId": null,
        "tags": ["sales", "legal"]
      },
      {
        "id": "7c1a0b52-9e88-4f0d-b3a2-1d4c6f8e2a90",
        "name": "Proposals",
        "type": "folder"
      }
    ],
    "total": 2
  }
}
```

## Pagination

Results are capped by `limit` (default applies when omitted). To page through a large library, increase `limit` or request successive pages and stop when the number of returned items is less than your `limit`.

## Common errors

| Status | Meaning | How to fix |
| ------ | ------- | ---------- |
| 401 | Missing or invalid API key | Send a valid `Authorization: Bearer` token. |
| 403 | Key lacks access to this org | Confirm `x-rapiddocx-org-id` matches the key's organization. |
